Name: Simple UI Themes 2 (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple UI Themes 2[/size][/b]
Bring a darker seasonal atmosphere to Stardew Valley with [b]36 themed palettes[/b], illustrated vines and corners, and subtle static glow.
Explore rainy blues, woodland greens, muted purples, warm browns, and wintry tones. The artwork draws from the valley’s flowers, crops, mushrooms, trees, stones, and weather.
[b]This is a standalone alternative to Simple UI Themes. The original mod is not required.[/b]
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]36 dark themes — nine per season[/b], each with matching decorative artwork.[/*]
[*]Dark coloured panels with adjusted text colours for readability.[/*]
[*]Themed menus, inventory frames, buttons, HUD elements, and tooltips.[/*]
[*]Hanging corner details, upright bottom decorations, and matching side vines.[/*]
[*]Static glow on suitable designs, with no animated ornaments.[/*]
[*]Optional seasonal backgrounds behind your farmer in the inventory.[/*]
[*]A colour-tile browser with decorated previews and visible selection markers.[/*]
[*]Keyboard and controller navigation in the theme picker.[/*]
[*]Support for all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[/list][heading]A different atmosphere for every season[/heading]
The collection includes a connected seasonal-weather family:
[list]
[*][b]Spring Showers:[/b] Rain-blue colours with blossoms and rainy details.[/*]
[*][b]Green Rain:[/b] Moss-green colours inspired by summer’s unusual weather.[/*]
[*][b]Autumn Downpour:[/b] Storm-grey colours with autumn foliage.[/*]
[*][b]Valley Snowfall:[/b] Snow-blue colours with winter decorations.[/*]
[/list]Other themes explore midnight flowers, shaded vineyards, mushrooms, pumpkins, woodland scenery, frozen lakes, and darker mineral colours.
[heading]Choose how your themes change[/heading]
[b]Fixed:[/b] Keep one theme throughout the year.
[b]Seasonal:[/b] Set a different preset for each season.
[b]Daily within season:[/b] Change themes automatically each in-game day while staying within the current season. Eligible themes are used before repeating, and today’s choice survives reloading.
Mark seasonal favourites to create a smaller rotation. With no favourites selected for a season, all nine themes are eligible.
Use [b]Next seasonal theme[/b] or an optional shuffle binding whenever you want another look for the current day.
[heading]Preview before choosing[/heading]
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, open a preset or [b]Browse and preview themes[/b] to enter the colour-tile browser directly.
Names follow [b]Season - Colour - Name[/b]. Preview the panel colours, button, tooltip, and decorative artwork before making your choice.
For a preset change, choose [b]Select[/b], then save your settings to apply it. [b]Cancel, Escape, or controller B[/b] discards the picker choice.
[heading]Appearance and readability[/heading]
Menu colours, HUD colours, tooltip colours, and seasonal farmer backgrounds have separate settings.
Text handling includes native menus and supported shared text used by other mods. Meaningful status colours remain distinct where supported.
Decorations adapt to supported panel layouts and available space. Whole pieces are omitted where they cannot fit safely, and individual configuration pages remain free of ornaments.
Glow is a static part of suitable artwork. There are no animation, glow-strength, or decoration-size controls.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Simple UI Themes 2 changes the interface’s appearance without changing item stats, inventory capacity, or game progression.
NPC portrait artwork, farmer sprites, and clothing are preserved. Standard menus and expanded inventory layouts are supported, while custom interfaces using their own rendering may need additional compatibility work.
Other UI recolours can conflict when they change the same elements.
[b]Enable only one edition: Simple UI Themes 2 or Simple UI Themes.[/b]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]SimpleUIThemes2[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game settings and the visual theme picker.[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Without it, edit the generated
[code]config.json[/code]while the game is closed.
Keep your existing
[code]config.json[/code]when updating to preserve your settings. Optional settings and shuffle shortcuts start unassigned.
[heading]Languages[/heading]
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, and Hungarian. The mod follows your game’s selected language.
[heading]Prefer softer colours?[/heading]
[b]Simple UI Themes[/b] offers 36 lighter seasonal palettes with its own matching decorations.
[heading]Reporting an issue[/heading]
If text is difficult to read or decorations overlap something, please share a screenshot, your SMAPI log, the selected theme, and any mods affecting that menu. Include your resolution and UI scale for layout issues.
